news.text: 👀 "#JoaoMario will probably not be bought by #Fiorentina, who could already try to return him to Turin in January.#Juventus could also keep him, perhaps in place of #Cabal, who is disappointing.The Colombian could then leave, while the Portuguese could return, although not necessarily to stay: he could be placed at another club."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀 "The requests of Luciano #Spalletti, #Juventus manager, for the winter mercato are clear:THE REQUESTS▪️ A left-back▫️ A forward, if #KoloMuani and #Woltemade fail to get going▪️ Depending on injuries, a midfielder to replace #Locatelli or #ThuramThese are the needs that #Carnevali, #Ottolini and #Massara will have to address."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

#Juventus, today partial training "with the group" - made up of players who featured less in yesterday's match, supplemented by some youth sector players -, for #McKennie and #Çelik ⚪️⚫️🆕[IlBianconero]
@GJustjuve posted a photo
🗣 Teun #Koopmeiners to 'SportMediaset': "An important victory for the standings? For everything, including morale. We want to continue like this".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Teun Koopmeiners to 'SportMediaset': "Negative performance after the 70th minute? Yes, that's true. We played deeper, we didn't press, but in the first 70 minutes we played very well, not conceding many chances either, even though they played a good game. In the last 20 minutes, we had to do better".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Teun #Koopmeiners to 'SportMediaset': "Did I score right in front of my brother Peer? In the second half, we played closer together, in the first half he was way out on the left and I told him: '2-0 eh' (laughs)".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Teun #Koopmeiners to 'SportMediaset': "What kind of night was it yesterday? It was a beautiful night, filled with so many emotions. I am definitely happy about my goal and the victory, but also about the pre-match choreography. I repeat, it was finally a beautiful night".[@juventusinsidernews]

🔙🆙 #Conceição and #Çelik could be on the bench for the match against #Fiorentina. While #McKennie, on Sunday, should be regularly available to the team. These potential returns would offer valuable rotations and high-quality alternatives to allow #Spalletti to manage energy levels in the best possible way.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

📋🧐 #Juventus may have found the right offensive balance with an evolution of the 3-5-2: the 3-4-3 (or the 3-4-2-1). #Spalletti's idea is to deploy #KoloMuani, #Alajbegović on the wings and #Woltemade as the striker. This allows the Frenchman to exploit his pace and attack the space in behind, while the Bosnian, and in the future #Yildiz, can start from a more central position to take players on and look for the shot.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

📊 Pape #Sarr's stats in the 2-1 victory of #Juventus away against #AZAlkmaar, in the Europa League.He returned to the starting lineup and, without #DouglasLuiz, took charge of pulling the strings in midfield.ON THE BALL▪️ 1 shot ▫️ 64 touches▪️ 92% passing accuracy, 100% in his own half▫️ 6 possessions lostIN DEFENSE▪️ 9 defensive contributions▫️ 3 duels won out of 4▪️ 0 times dribbled past[@junews24com via @PuebloJ]

📊 Federico #Gatti's stats in the 2-1 victory of #Juventus away against #AZAlkmaar, in the Europa League:ON THE BALL▪️ 1 shot▫️ 58 touches▪️ 84% passing accuracy▫️ 7 possessions lost▪️ 3 progressive carriesIN DEFENSE▫️ 9 defensive contributions▪️ 5 interceptions and 5 recoveries▫️ 1 tackle won and 4 ground duels won▪️ 0 times dribbles past[@junews24com via @PuebloJ]

👀 #Milan is trying to beat #Juventus in the race for Nicolò #Tresoldi, the Italian-German born in 2004 and playing for #Brugge.The rossoneri would be willing to try and buy him as early as January, to cut out the bianconeri, who are now interested in a June move.#BRUGGEA lot will depend on the Belgian club.They might not want to part with #Tresoldi mid-season, or they could demand a particularly high fee to let him go ahead of schedule.#Milan and #Juve are waiting to see what Club #Brugge's true intentions are.[@MatteMoretto via @TUTTOJUVE_COM - @PuebloJ]

🧣⚪⚫ #Carnevali keeps his promise!During the Shareholders Meeting, a shareholder asked him to wear a #Juventus scarf. Said and done: in Alkmaar, the CEO showed it off for the first time in the stands, aided by the Dutch cold. He had received it as a gift just a few days ago.[IlBianconero]

❌ Several #Juventus players will not be joining their national teams during the November international break.#WOLTEMADEHe was a starter in Alkmaar, but this time Klopp decided to leave him out of the Germany squad.He will stay at la Continassa and will not play against Serbia and the Netherlands.#CONCEIÇAOHe will not join his national team either: in addition to his shoulder injury, a suspension weighs heavily on the decision.THE BRAZILIANS#DouglasLuiz and #Bremer are staying home.THOSE WHO ARE GOING▪️ Practically certain to be called up by their managers: #Vicario, #Lucumí, #Sarr, #Koopmeiners, #Alajbegović and #Zhegrova ▫️ #Ekhator earned his spot in the Under-21 of Baldini▪️ Pochettino ha

🤞 #Spalletti hopes for the returns of #McKennie, #Conceição and #Çelik for the next match against #Fiorentina. The return of the American is practically certain, while if the path of caution prevails, the other two will be seen back on the pitch against #Venezia after the break.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @AroundJuventus]
🗣️ Luciano #Spalletti after #AZJuve:"What did I think about the 2-2 goal? I was choosing who to choke in the locker room."[@AroundJuventus]

🇳🇱💪 The goal against #AZ could represent a turning point for #Koopmeiners: compared to last year, he seems to be improving, but now consistency is needed. #Spalletti needs his contribution, considering that he is probably the most complete midfielder in the squad, capable of guaranteeing balance, quality and goals. The European night could help him regain confidence and self-esteem.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]
